The Staff Clinical Pharmacist 2 Per Diem position focuses on inpatient care with an emphasis in a variety of patient care areas. The Staff Clinical Pharmacist 2 Per Diem works primarily in the inpatient setting, covers select specialty services, and provides both clinical and distribution support to hospitalized patients.
65% - Clinical Pharmacist

The Staff Clinical Pharmacist 2 Per Diem is responsible for directing and maintaining drug therapy across the continuum of care, providing comprehensive service-based monitoring on select services, as well as focused monitoring in the areas of supportive care, symptom management, antimicrobial management, anticoagulation, pain, and parenteral nutrition therapy. The Staff Clinical Pharmacist 2 Per Diem continuously seeks out interventions by making rounds with the medical teams and offering suggestions on individualized medication regimens, including transitions of care needs during hospital admission and discharge. #CA-DS
15% - Fosters Academic Excellence
20% - Facilitates Drug Distribution and Support Staff
